data.notes: May 2026 in Tbilisi is especially strong for club-focused travel, with Bassiani and KHIDI anchoring the calendar alongside major one-off electronic, jazz, and pop concerts.

events.title: Bassiani / Horoom x La Noche: Kr!z, Sandrien, Hamatsuki, Kancheli b2b Newa
events.summary: Bassiani’s May 1 edition pairs international techno names Kr!z and Sandrien with Hamatsuki and a Kancheli b2b Newa set, while Horoom hosts a La Noche takeover with Byron Yeates, DHC, Edge and THC.

events.title: Bassiani x Eerste Communie: Rene Wise & Amoral, Hitam, Mari Sakurai, Richard Akingbehin
events.summary: Amsterdam party series Eerste Communie takes over Bassiani with Rene Wise & Amoral, Hitam live, Mari Sakurai, Richard Akingbehin and WINDFUHR. Horoom adds ATEQ, Dito, HVL live and Kdema.

events.title: KHIDI: Bloody Mary, Espen Lauritzen, Frequency Shifter, Regal
events.summary: KHIDI’s May 8 lineup is led by Regal and Bloody Mary, with Espen Lauritzen and resident Frequency Shifter on the main floor. G2 hosts Elene, Memotech and Sevda.

events.title: Janoshka Ensemble and Tbilisi Symphony Orchestra
events.venueName: Jansug Kakhidze Center for Music and Culture
events.summary: The Janoshka Ensemble performs with the Tbilisi Symphony Orchestra for the opening concert of the Djansug Kakhidze 11th International Music Festival.

events.title: Adam Port (Keinemusik)
events.summary: Mono Hall and Boom Boom Booking Agency present Adam Port of Keinemusik at Mtatsminda Park for a large-scale house and Afro-house event.

events.title: Eau De Cologne x PRNCPTL
events.summary: Eau De Cologne closes its season at Bassiani with a collaboration with Berlin queer collective Pornceptual. The lineup features Anketa, Citizens Union, Natuta, Rachel Noon and VINVAR.

events.title: Electro Deluxe and Tbilisi Symphony Orchestra
events.venueName: Jansug Kakhidze Center for Music and Culture
events.summary: French jazz-funk group Electro Deluxe performs with the Tbilisi Symphony Orchestra as part of the Djansug Kakhidze 11th International Music Festival.

events.title: Vini Vici
events.summary: Psytrance duo Vini Vici return to Tbilisi for a MonoHall show on May 15.

events.title: Till Brönner Quintet and Tbilisi Symphony Orchestra
events.venueName: Jansug Kakhidze Center for Music and Culture
events.summary: German trumpeter Till Brönner and his quintet join the Tbilisi Symphony Orchestra for jazz standards and Brönner compositions at the Djansug Kakhidze festival.

events.title: Shimza x NOISE
events.summary: NOISE brings South African Afro-house artist Shimza to Underwheel Terrace for his first Georgia appearance.

events.title: Horoom: Hamatsuki live, Mancho, Neon Warrior, nthng
events.summary: Horoom’s May 30 program features Hamatsuki live, Mancho, Neon Warrior and atmospheric electronic producer nthng.

events.title: Kovacs in Tbilisi
events.summary: Dutch singer Sharon Kovacs plays Republic Event Hall with material spanning her soul-jazz catalogue and newer electronic-leaning work.
